title: Vector representation quantization consistency harness and nullspace checks
creator: Marina Cole
description: Goal: Build an automated harness and workflow to produce INT8 and FP16 quantization profiles for our vector models, validate accuracy using angular/cosine similarity metrics, and detect early "erosion" in representation space (nullspace drift). This ticket covers: design of calibration dataset selection, deterministic calibration run artifacts, evaluation harness for similarity/regression checks, canary rollout triggers, and integration points with Console alerting. Deliverables: reproducible calibration artifacts (per-model profiles), an evaluation report with per-query similarity deltas, a drift detector that flags rolling-window degradation, and a runbook for remediation. Out of scope: retraining or new model finetuning; those will be follow-ups if degradation exceeds thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration harness can generate INT8 and FP16 profiles reproducibly (seeded runs produce identical quant tables)
Per-model validation report produced for each calibration with: mean cosine similarity, median similarity, 95th percentile drop, and per-slice breakdown (length, frequency bucket)
Defined guardrail: aggregate mean cosine similarity drop <= 0.012 (1.2%) relative to FP32 baseline on primary holdout set, and 95th percentile drop <= 0.03
Drift detector alerts when a 7-day rolling mean similarity drops by >0.01 or when 1-hour window shows >0.025 spike in degradation; alerts must create a ticket and post to #runtime-alerts
Canary rollout workflow for deploying quantized model variants: 5% traffic for 24h + pass similarity checks, 25% for 24h, then gradual ramp with automated rollback on failing metrics
Artifacts and reports are accessible from Console and linked in Confluence; sample PR demonstrates integration for one production model
tasks: Define representative calibration corpora and holdout splits (static seed + stratification by token length)
Implement deterministic calibration runner in quant-service with config schema versioning
Add evaluation module: compute cosine/angular similarity distribution, pairwise KS test vs baseline, and per-slice diagnostics
Build drift detector: ingest nightly evaluation deltas, compute rolling-window stats, wire to PagerDuty/Slack
Create canary orchestration docs and automate traffic-splitting in the runtime for quant variants
Add CI job: run quick calibration + similarity smoke test on PRs touching quant codepaths
Produce Confluence runbook with remediation steps and links to dashboards/PRs

notes: Design decisions: prefer cosine similarity (normalized dot) over Euclidean for scale-invariant checks; complement similarity checks with a recall-on-k nearest-neighbor test for select datasets. Risk: tight guardrails may block beneficial quant gains; we'll add an "allowlist" for low-risk cohorts after manual review. Operationally, ensure canary automatic rollback does not oscillate due to short-lived noise — use hysteresis on triggers.
